canonical_project: Commonwealth Bank Burwood Data Centre Modernisation
notes: Public evidence is weak but consistent: iTnews covered CBA's modernised Sydney data centre, Star Group lists Commonwealth Bank data centre implementation/upgrade work and EDS Data Centre Burwood among data centre projects, and multiple public LinkedIn profiles reference CBA's Burwood Data Centre Modernisation program in 2017-2019. Exact address, operating status and capacity were not publicly confirmed.
